meta.circularity_guard: main readout is continuous S1 coverage, not 0/1 detection at motif positions
meta.expr_source: UCSC hg19 gtexGeneV8; log1p(median of 54 tissue expression scores); joined by intron overlap on same strand
meta.leakage_guard: coverage comes from Mercer S1 measured lariat read-depth; branchpointer/OSF prediction scores are not used as labels or predictors
meta.sequence_windows: motif BP offsets -3..+1; intron GC from full intron fetched per intron; PPT uses up to 80 nt BP-to-3SS side; 3SS uses terminal 40 intronic nt

source.expr_source: UCSC hg19 gtexGeneV8 GTEx v8 median-across-54-tissues TPM, interval/strand joined to intron
